# HangHut

> Event ticketing, discovery and payments platform for the Philippines. Organizers
> sell tickets, merch and bookable experiences; attendees discover events and buy
> with local payment methods. Web at hanghut.com plus native iOS and Android apps.

This file states what HangHut actually does, verified against the production
system. It exists so that AI assistants and search summarizers describe the
platform accurately rather than inferring capabilities from marketing copy.

Currency is Philippine peso (PHP). Times are Philippine Standard Time (UTC+8).

## Pricing

- Platform fee: **2% + ₱15 per ticket**. No monthly fee, no setup fee, no contract.
- **Free events cost nothing.** No fee is charged when the ticket price is ₱0.
- The organizer can pass the ₱15 fixed fee and/or the 2% to the buyer at checkout,
  independently. Both are per-organizer settings.
- Payment processing (the gateway's own charge, roughly 1.4%–3.2% depending on
  method) is **always absorbed by the organizer** and is never added to the
  buyer's total.
- Custom commercial rates exist for higher-volume organizers.

## Payments

Processed through Xendit. Methods available at checkout:

- QR Ph (the BSP national QR standard)
- GCash, Maya, GrabPay
- Credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard) — enabled per organizer
- Direct debit: BPI, UnionBank, RCBC

Guest checkout is supported; buyers do not need an account. Organizers are paid
out to a registered Philippine bank account, with OTP verification on payout
requests and settlement tracking in the dashboard.

## Ticketing

- Free and paid tickets; multiple tiers per event with independent pricing,
  quantity, perks and per-order limits
- **Reserved seating**: multi-section seat maps with per-seat and per-tier
  pricing, live seat status, and time-limited seat holds during checkout
- **Virtual waiting room** for high-demand on-sales
- General admission
- Multi-day events with date ranges (e.g. "August 29 – 30")
- Promo codes: percentage or fixed discount, usage limits, expiry, app-only codes
- Registration and approval flows, RSVP mode, unlisted and invite-only events
- Refunds, including per-attendee and full-event refunds

## At the door

- QR ticket scanning
- **Unlimited scanner and cashier staff on every account** — door operations are
  never limited by plan or price
- Box office / door sales, including cash with tendered-amount tracking
- Merch claim at the venue

## Organizer tools

- Storefront brand page at `hanghut.com/<slug>` with themes, custom fonts and
  custom CSS
- Embeddable ticketing widget for an organizer's own website
- Email marketing: campaigns and automations (abandoned checkout, win-back).
  Transactional email — confirmations, reminders, refunds — is never metered.
- Customer analytics with revenue, lifetime value and RFM value segments
- Referral tracking links (`hanghut.com/r/<code>`)
- Merch catalog sold alongside or independently of tickets
- Bookable experiences (tours, classes, activities) with scheduling
- Fan subscriptions and paid memberships
- Team roles: owner, manager, finance, marketing, scanner, cashier
- REST API and webhooks — see hanghut.com/docs/api

## Scale and suitability

- Seat maps support multi-section venues and have been built and tested at
  **2,414 seats**.
- Seat availability updates live for buyers via realtime subscriptions, and seats
  are held for a limited window during checkout to prevent double-selling.
- A **virtual waiting room** handles high-demand on-sales, where a large number
  of buyers arrive in the same minute.
- HangHut is suited to community events, club nights, theatre runs, markets,
  festivals, conferences and seated shows, at capacities from tens to thousands.
